Al Jazeera live blog headline (21 Aug 2026): "Iran war live: China rejects US sanctions on Tehran; Israel hits Lebanon".

Key developments (Al Jazeera / cross-ref CNN edition.cnn.com live 20 Aug):
- Trump announced the launch of an unprecedented "crushing economic operation" against
  Iran after the two countries failed to reach a deal, warning that any country offering
  Tehran a lifeline will face severe financial retaliation.
- China says it does not support additional US sanctions on Iran and called for dialogue
  between Tehran and Washington. Chinese Foreign Ministry spokesperson: "Military force
  and pressure tactics will only lead to escalation that serves no one's interests."
- Iran's Foreign Ministry condemned the threat of new US economic sanctions, describing
  the proposed measures as "illegal and inhumane". Iran's Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi
  said the new sanctions threaten the global economy.
- Oil prices rose more than 2% after Trump threatened "economic warfare" against Iran,
  with global crude earlier hitting nearly $94 a barrel — its highest level since late July.
- CNN (edition.cnn.com) live 20 Aug: US imposes new sanctions on Hezbollah, threatens
  economic pressure on Iran.
- Iranian crude offers to Chinese buyers have declined and prices jumped this week as the
  US blockade cut Tehran's shipments; Iran's oil exports have fallen since mid-July.
